# Cultural Imprint Engine (CIE)

CIE is CrownThrive's cultural identity and ecosystem architecture framework. It structures identity, narrative, audience, voice, representation constraints, cultural commitments and ecosystem routing across products, media, commerce, advertising, licensing, analytics and AI.

CIE becomes useful when identity decisions multiply across channels, brands, teams, agencies, AI systems, sponsors, licensees, affiliates, ads, and distribution partners. It is not merely a style guide. It creates a machine-usable imprint object that can carry identity, audience, voice, goals, guardrails, rights context, channel rules, and evidence expectations into downstream execution.

The How It Works page documents the public method as an eight-step pipeline: capture and normalize identity context; classify imprint family; detect drift exposure; compute transparent public lens diagnostics; build the ecosystem route; project provider-neutral PentaAds context where relevant; return an evidence envelope; and map implementation scope to the matching commercial tier. Public scoring is explicitly transparent demo logic, not protected CrownThrive calibration.

The public CIE Live Lab executes a real deterministic Vercel scenario runner. It returns a run ID, timestamp, server duration, imprint classification, six public lens scores, drift findings, ecosystem route, commercial-fit recommendation, PentaAds projection, before/after state, stage-by-stage show-your-work explanations, and raw JSON evidence. The demo runner uses no protected CrownThrive calibration, provider credentials, ad-spend authority, payment authority, persistence, or third-party provider writes.

Five verified public scenario classes are available: salon, media, platform, institution, and agency. The shareable GET proof bridge performs a real POST to the canonical production runner and returns the fresh run object for inspection.

Five imprint families: institutional, corridor, platform, media/channel, and brand/campaign.
Six public lenses: identity depth, cultural contribution, ecosystem gravity, economic utility, scalability + longevity, and imprint power.

Commercial tiers: Operator $299, Studio $799, Agency $2,499, Institutional $4,999, Enterprise $7,500. API/MCP and the PentaAds bridge begin at Studio. Conditional resale, sublicensing, white-label and OEM rights require the appropriate signed CrownThrive addendum.
